newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to take 1.6 bln peso Q4 write-off.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to take 1.6 bln peso Q4 write-off.

text.p: Mexican telephone giant Telefonos de Mexico S.A. said on Tuesday that it plans to take a 1.6 billion peso one-time charge during the fourth quarter.

Gerardo Munoz, head of investor relations at Telmex, told Reuters the item represents a write-off of goodwill from Telmex's acquisitions last year of cable company Cablevision and telcomms company Red Uno and its 1989 purchase of a microwave network from the government.
The goodwill would have otherwise been amortized over a period of 10 years, according to Telmex.
He said it is a non-cash item that will not affect Telmex's cash flow. Bear Stearns brokerage said earlier it estimated the charge will amount to 30 cents per ADR during the fourth quarter.
